subject: english
question:
Select the word segment that substitutes (replaces) the bracketed word segment correctly and completes the sentence meaningfully. In case no improvement is needed, select ‘No improvement’.

Nonetheless, (many an old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, has) kept their romances to the end.

options.text: many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have
many old poets, such Tennyson and Browning, has
many a old poets, such Tennyson and Browning, has

solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **correct answer** is** "many old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, have".**
 
• In the original sentence, "many an old poets, such as Tennyson and Browning, has&am
